title: Please stop with the countdown of “special offer ending”
body:
Since my last review about the annoying countdown offers, there are now TWO overlapping ones. Please please please stop all of this. 
***
This supposed “limited time special offer ending”countdown has been on the app for years - please think of something else. I’m still never going to pay for pro, because there will likely be something else annoying always popping up - and the temptation for removal of this incessant “offer” pop up would be the only reason to do so. It’s the oldest, laziest trick in the app marketing playbook, and it’s tired. Please do better.

title: Too pushy with subscription
body: I just wanted an easy-to-navigate app to help with building habits. Done app (free version) seemed to tick my very basic boxes. However when I open the app, a pop up screen with a ‘limited time offer’ subscription comes up. At first I ignored it because I thought it was a welcome offer for new users. However after a month I still get that pop up EVERY SINGLE TIME I open the app to check in. Which is annoying and defies the definition of ‘limited time’. Soooo, I will be looking for another app that isn’t so pushy with their subscription.

title: Used to be great, too many recent changes and glitches
body: I started using this 2+ years ago and loved it. It had a lot of customisable options and synced well with my Apple watch. About a year ago they started updating and making changes to the design. Initially it worked fine but as of recently there has been issues. My apple watch doesn't update as it did. I can't add tasks that are tracked over a month or a year any more, can only do days or weeks. Today they changed the view to go by day, week or month... What was wrong with the previous one where I could arrange the tasks my self. Now it's not reading the count for the week correctly. Instead of starting the week in Monday, it's counting from last week, seems to be a glitch. I'm sticking with it as I've paid for it, but if you are a new user, I would no longer recommend this app
